mapper.select: SELECT scope_kind,dimension,maximum,consumed,reserved FROM agent_runtime_budget_balances WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ((scope_kind='ROOT' AND scope_id=#{root}) OR (scope_kind IN ('RUN','STAGE_BASE') AND scope_id=#{run}))
mapper.update:
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_balances b SET reserved=b.reserved+a.reserved, maximum=CASE WHEN b.scope_kind='STAGE' THEN a.maximum ELSE b.maximum END FROM (VALUES
(#{a.dimension}::text,#{a.reserved}::bigint,#{a.maximum}::bigint) ) AS a(dimension,reserved,maximum) WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.dimension=a.dimension AND ((b.scope_kind='ROOT' AND b.scope_id=#{root}) OR (b.scope_kind IN ('RUN','STAGE') AND b.scope_id=#{run}))

UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_balances b SET consumed=b.consumed+a.reported,reserved=b.reserved-a.reserved FROM (VALUES
(#{a.dimension}::text,#{a.reserved}::bigint,#{a.reported}::bigint) ) AS a(dimension,reserved,reported) WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.dimension=a.dimension AND ((b.scope_kind='ROOT' AND b.scope_id=#{root}) OR (b.scope_kind IN ('RUN','STAGE') AND b.scope_id=#{run}))
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts SET settled=true WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND NOT settled AND dimension IN #{a.dimension}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_budget_activity(tenant_id,run_id,interval_id,started_at,confirmed_through) VALUES (#{tenant},#{run},#{id},#{start},#{through}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,run_id,interval_id) DO UPDATE SET confirmed_through=GREATEST(agent_runtime_budget_activity.confirmed_through,EXCLUDED.confirmed_through) WHERE agent_runtime_budget_activity.started_at=EXCLUDED.started_at RETURNING started_at,confirmed_through
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_budget_roots(tenant_id,root_id,scenario,source_version,active_limit_seconds) VALUES (#{tenant},#{root},#{scenario},#{version},#{seconds}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempts SET state='SENT' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND state='RESERVED'
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts SET reported=reserved WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND dimension IN ('BUSINESS_MODELS','AUXILIARY_MODELS','TOOLS','KNOWLEDGE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_budget_result_receipts(tenant_id,attempt_id,result_reference) VALUES (#{tenant},#{attempt},#{reference}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempts SET state='RESULT_SAVED',result_reference=#{reference} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND state IN ('SENT','RESULT_SAVED','SETTLED')
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempts SET state='RESULT_SAVED',result_reference=#{reference} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND state='RESERVED'
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts SET reported=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND reported IS NULL

UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_attempts SET state='SETTLED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND state='RESULT_SAVED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts WHERE tenant_id=#{pendingTenant} AND attempt_id=#{pendingAttempt} AND NOT settled)

UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_balances b SET maximum=0 FROM agent_runtime_budget_runs r WHERE b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.scope_id=r.run_id AND b.scope_kind='CLOSING_RUN' AND r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.root_id=#{root}

UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_balances b SET maximum=a.maximum FROM (VALUES
(#{a.dimension}::text,#{a.maximum}::bigint) ) AS a(dimension,maximum) WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.dimension=a.dimension AND ((b.scope_kind='CLOSING' AND b.scope_id=#{root}) OR (b.scope_kind='CLOSING_RUN' AND b.scope_id=#{run}))
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_roots SET closing_active_seconds=#{seconds},closing_run_id=#{run} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_id=#{root}
UPDATE agent_runtime_budget_roots SET phase='CLOSING' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_id=#{root}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_budget_closing_targets(tenant_id,run_id,target_handle) VALUES (#{tenant},#{run},#{handle}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO agent_runtime_budget_balances(tenant_id,scope_kind,scope_id,dimension,maximum) VALUES
(#{tenant},#{kind},#{scope},#{a.dimension},#{a.maximum})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT run_id AS "runId",fingerprint,category,closing,state FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt}
SELECT closing FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND attempt_id=#{attempt}
SELECT state FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND attempt_id=#{attempt}
SELECT dimension,reserved,reported FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND reported IS NOT NULL AND NOT settled
SELECT attempt_id FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND state='RESULT_SAVED'
SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_budget_closing_targets WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND target_handle=#{handle}
SELECT closing_active_seconds FROM agent_runtime_budget_roots WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_id=#{root}

SELECT a.started_at,a.confirmed_through FROM agent_runtime_budget_activity a JOIN agent_runtime_budget_runs r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.run_id=a.run_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.run_id=#{scope}r.root_id=#{scope} ORDER BY a.started_at
SELECT started_at,confirmed_through FROM agent_runtime_budget_activity WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND interval_id LIKE 'output-closing-model:%' ORDER BY started_at

SELECT r.root_id AS "rootId",r.role,r.source_version AS "sourceVersion",r.active_limit_seconds AS "runActiveSeconds",b.scenario,b.active_limit_seconds AS "rootActiveSeconds" FROM agent_runtime_budget_runs r JOIN agent_runtime_budget_roots b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.root_id=r.root_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.run_id=#{run}
SELECT phase FROM agent_runtime_budget_roots WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_id=#{root}
SELECT root_id FROM agent_runtime_budget_roots WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_id=#{root} FOR UPDATE
SELECT dimension,maximum,consumed,reserved FROM agent_runtime_budget_balances WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_kind=#{kind} AND scope_id=#{scope}
SELECT dimension,reserved FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt_id=#{attempt}
